name: the-world
description: Electron-hosted procedural AI NPC demo for @game-llm.

scripts.build: npm run build:deps && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:deps: npm run build --workspace @game-llm/core && npm run build --workspace @game-llm/ollama && npm run build --workspace @game-llm/litert-lm && npm run build --workspace @game-llm/omlx && npm run build --workspace @game-llm/electron
scripts.dev: npm run build:deps && npm run build:main && concurrently -k --success first "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:5179 file:dist/main/main.js && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5179 electron ."
